fields.Language: C++ (CMake), plus `spiOverJtag/` gateware for other vendors
fields.Toolchain: CMake + libftdi/libusb; also bundled in YosysHQ oss-cad-suite
fields.Target: Universal FPGA programmer (Xilinx, Intel, Lattice, Gowin, Efinix, Anlogic, Cologne Chip)
fields.Activity: 2095 commits, 2019-09-26 → 2026-09-23, very active. Latest release v1.1.1 (2026-03-11). Main author Gwenhael Goavec-Merou

sections.title: What it does for the ULX3S

blocks.text: Only the ULX3S-specific parts were reviewed (`src/board.hpp`, `src/cable.hpp`, `doc/boards.yml`, udev rules).

rows.Transport: `ft231X` cable: FT231X on US1 (0403:6015) in **bit-bang** JTAG mode
rows.Notes: TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO on DCD/DSR/RI/CTS. SRAM + SPI flash
Needs the DFU bootloader from emard/had2019-playground (binaries in [ulx3s-bin](emard__ulx3s-bin.md)); flash only
Added 2025-04-18. The commit message says "it doesn't work" at that point; current status unverified

blocks.text:
openFPGALoader -b ulx3s design.bit             # SRAM (default, -m optional)
openFPGALoader -b ulx3s -f design.bit          # SPI flash
openFPGALoader -b ulx3s design.bit.gz          # gzip accepted
openFPGALoader -b ulx3s_dfu design.bit         # via US2 DFU bootloader
openFPGALoader -b ulx3s --unprotect-flash --file-type bin -f multiboot.img.gz   # install bootloader image
openFPGALoader --detect -b ulx3s               # read IDCODE

udev: `70-openfpgaloader.rules` (uaccess) or `99-…` (group plugdev) include FT231X 0403:6015
and ULX3S/ULX4M DFU 1d50:614b.

items: The recommended programmer for ULX3S today, and the default in our advice ([toolchain memory](../../.claude/memory/toolchain-and-programming.md)).

Bit-banged FT231X JTAG is slow. For large 85F bitstreams, an external FT2232 on the JTAG
header (`-c ft2232`) or DFU is faster.
